It doesnt work. works on other websites. even here. what is wrong?

It looks like the website you're trying to access might be blocking the standard shortcut for opening developer tools in Chrome. In such cases, you can still access the developer tools by right-clicking anywhere on the webpage and selecting "Inspect" from the context menu. Alternatively, you can open the Chrome menu by clicking the three dots in the upper right corner, then select "More tools" and then "Developer tools." If none of these methods work, it's possible that the website is intentionally blocking developer tools from being opened. In this case, you may need to contact the website owner or find an alternative way to view the page source code.
